introCopy: 27 years of Chai Wallahs proved something — that you can run things fairly, pay people properly, and build a real community, and it works. Not as a nice idea. As a model that lasts. Where It All Began is what happens when the same people ask: what if we built a whole festival that way? It's not our name on someone else's idea. It's the same hands, the same standards, the same belief — applied to something bigger than one stage.

doesMean.text: Same people. Same standards. New scale.
Chai's history is the proof this way works.
When we talk about WIAB, we're the people behind it — not the brand behind it.

doesntMean.text: We don't lend our name to take the credit.
This isn't a rebrand of Chai — it's something new, from people you already know.

venuesIntro: Held at the iconic home of Secret Garden Party — Grange Farm, Abbots Ripton. Alongside sharing the site, the SGP team programme their own stage, bringing their unmistakable spirit and creative chaos into the heart of the festival. A familiar setting, reimagined for something new.
festivalCopy: A place where the creative spirit and the core values of festival culture are upheld. High quality production is standard, musical diversity the foundation, and audiences feel valued, respected, and part of a deep sense of community. No shareholders. Artists paid fairly. Every partner benefits from the success.
festivalMeta: Fri 18 – Sun 20 June 2027 · Grange Farm, Abbots Ripton, Cambridgeshire
